newsitem.title: USA: Interactive gets new symbol on Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Interactive gets new symbol on Nasdaq.

text.p: Interactive Entertainment Limited -- formerly Sky Games International Ltd -- said on Tuesday it received approval to trade under the symbol IELSF.O on the Nasdaq Small Cap Market.

On June 16 the company's shareholders approved changes necessary in connection with a merger of the company with one of its direct subsidiaries and an indirect subsidiary then known as Interactive Entertainment Ltd.
Interactive Entertainment develops remote control gaming entertainment software for use in the international long-haul airline industry.
